description: A concrete gym. A young woman in a coral sports top sits in a round metal tub full of icy water, screaming and laughing as a blonde woman in black gym clothes pours a whole bucket of ice cubes over her head. Ice splashes out onto the black rubber floor. The blonde woman lowers the empty bucket and leans over the tub laughing, while the young woman in the tub grips its edge and shivers. On the right a young man sits laughing with ice packs strapped to his knees, and people train behind.

en.question: Where is the woman in pink sitting?

de.answer: Sie sitzt in einer Wanne mit eiskaltem Wasser.

es.answer: Está sentada en una tina de agua helada.
